summary: Man fell hundreds of feet from a ridge on Citadel Peak on the Continental Divide; his body was recovered by 8 p.m. after a Black Hawk inserted Alpine Rescue Team members; his 29-year-old climbing partner was stranded on the ridge and rescued uninjured.
location: Citadel Peak, Continental Divide (near Berthoud Pass / Eisenhower Tunnel)
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team, Colorado National Guard (Black Hawk)
notes: Alpine log 2025-141 paged 12/31/25 14:05 for an injured mountaineer who fell on the Citadel; some news reports describe the rescue continuing into Jan 1, 2026.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Clear Creek County, Colorado, United States)
